title: Ulster Trophy, Dundrod (1955)
authorisationNote: Viewed on the BFI's own free player — linked out, not embedded here.
description: Seven minutes of the May 1955 Ulster Trophy meeting: the main stand, cars at speed on the country roads, and the race Desmond Titterington won as fastest finisher.
rightsHolder: Northern Ireland Screen Digital Film Archive (streamed on BFI Player)

title: Ulster Tourist Trophy (1950)
description: Silent, unissued Pathé footage catalogued as TT racing in Ulster, 1950 — a minute and a half from the circuit's first Tourist Trophy season.
authorisationNote: Viewed on British Pathé's own site — linked out, not embedded or rehosted here.

title: Stirling Moss and the RAC Tourist Trophy Race (1955)
rightsHolder: Northern Ireland Screen Digital Film Archive
description: Moss and his fellow drivers on the Dundrod roads in the Golden Jubilee Tourist Trophy of 17 September 1955 — the race he and Fitch won, and the circuit's last. The archive notes the film includes the race's accidents; it is presented by Northern Ireland Screen with that context.
authorisationNote: Viewed on Northern Ireland Screen's own Digital Film Archive player — linked out, not embedded or rehosted here.
